known.via: English Wikipedia "Swan Valley (wine)" (redirects to "Swan Valley (Western Australia)")

climate: Most rain falls in winter. Dry summers keep mildew and rot down, though young vines may need watering.

blurb.text: A Western Australia subregion of Swan District in the upper reaches of the Swan River, registered in 2003.
